g.desc: {"kind":"workflow","id":"checkout","title":"A customer checks out","subtitle":"two services, two topics","description":"One order produces two events, each on its own topic. Neither producer knows who reads them.","steps":[{"id":"place","title":"Checkout publishes the order","description":"[Checkout](#producers.checkout) appends `order.placed` to [orders](#broker.orders) and answers the customer at once.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(producers.checkout -> broker.orders)[0]"}]},{"id":"capture","title":"Payments publishes the capture","description":"Once the card is charged, [Payments](#producers.payments) appends `payment.captured` to [payments](#broker.captured).","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(producers.payments -> broker.captured)[0]"}]}]}

g.desc: {"kind":"element","path":"broker","label":"Kafka","caption":"durable log","description":"Topics keep events for 7 days. A consumer that falls behind resumes from its last committed offset."}

{"kind":"workflow","id":"react","title":"Consumers react at their own pace","subtitle":"one event, many consumers","description":"Each consumer group reads [the orders topic](#broker.orders) independently, so a slow [warehouse load](#react/load) never delays [the confirmation email](#react/confirm).","steps":[{"id":"confirm","title":"Notifications emails the customer","description":"[Notifications](#consumers.notify) needs only the order to send the confirmation.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(broker.orders -> consumers.notify)[0]"},{"edge":"(consumers.notify -> mail)[0]"}]},{"id":"ship","title":"Fulfillment ships a paid order","description":"[Fulfillment](#consumers.fulfillment) reads both topics and joins them by order id.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(broker.orders -> consumers.fulfillment)[0]"},{"edge":"(broker.captured -> consumers.fulfillment)[0]"}]},{"id":"load","title":"Analytics loads the warehouse hourly","description":"[Analytics](#consumers.analytics) buffers both topics and writes one batch per hour.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(broker.orders -> consumers.analytics)[0]"},{"edge":"(broker.captured -> consumers.analytics)[0]"},{"edge":"(consumers.analytics -> warehouse)[0]"}]}]}

{"kind":"workflow","id":"lag","title":"A consumer falls behind","subtitle":"the log keeps what it missed","description":"[Analytics](#consumers.analytics) is down for an afternoon. [Kafka](#broker) keeps every event for 7 days, so nothing is lost.","steps":[{"id":"pile","title":"Orders keep coming","description":"[Checkout](#producers.checkout) keeps publishing and [Notifications](#consumers.notify) keeps emailing; only the analytics offset stops moving.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(producers.checkout -> broker.orders)[0]"},{"edge":"(broker.orders -> consumers.notify)[0]"},{"element":"consumers.analytics"}]},{"id":"resume","title":"Analytics resumes from its last offset","description":"On restart it reads from its last committed offset, not from the newest event.","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(broker.orders -> consumers.analytics)[0]"}]},{"id":"catch-up","title":"One load closes the gap","description":"The next hourly load carries the whole backlog to [the warehouse](#warehouse).","layer":1,"items":[{"edge":"(consumers.analytics -> warehouse)[0]"}]}]}
